event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen.why: 文字是灶旁「一盒供人取用的備用忍具」，圖裡是插著湯勺鐵夾的廚具盒；同事件 r1 的備用品盒裝的是手裡劍與小炸彈，兩張要一致。灶邊貼的紙條也沒畫。
event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen.scene: SETTING on a small patch of rough stone floor, the SAME kitchen corner as in reference image 3: a stone stove with a glowing wood fire in its opening and a big dark iron soup pot on top, full of bubbling stew. The pot lid is pushed up by the steam: it jumps above the rim, tilted, with puffs of white steam bursting out from under it. A small paper note is stuck flat on the front of the stove beside the fire opening; it shows only a simple ink drawing of a steaming bowl (a picture, no writing). On the floor right beside the stove stands the SPARE NINJA-TOOL BOX of reference image 3: an open wooden crate filled with silver throwing stars (shuriken) and small round black bombs with short fuses, with a small paper chart of simple ink pictures (a throwing star, a bomb) propped up against the crate. The crate holds ONLY ninja tools: NO ladles, NO spoons, NO tongs, NO towels, no kitchen tools anywhere. Dangdang stands on the floor on the other side of the stove, leaning forward and peeking curiously at the jumping pot lid, both paws raised in front of his chest, NOT touching the hot pot. Curious face, mouth slightly open.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen_r1.webp

the kitchen of this same event to copy: the stone stove with the fire opening, the big dark iron soup pot with its lid, the rough stone floor, and above all the SPARE NINJA-TOOL BOX - the open wooden crate full of silver throwing stars and round black bombs with the small picture chart propped against it. Copy the crate exactly. Do NOT copy Dangdang's pose from it.

event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen_r0.why: 連帶修正（工單外）：主圖灶旁的盒子改成跟 r1 一樣裝手裡劍與小炸彈的備用品盒後，這張同一位置還是插湯勺鐵夾的廚具盒，同一事件前後不一。喝湯的動作是對的，保留。
event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen_r0.scene: SETTING: the SAME kitchen corner as in reference image 3, on the same small patch of rough stone floor: the stone stove with the glowing fire, the big dark iron soup pot with its lid tilted open and steam rising, the small paper note with the ink drawing of a steaming bowl stuck on the stove front, and right beside the stove the SAME SPARE NINJA-TOOL BOX: the open wooden crate full of silver throwing stars and small round black bombs, with the small picture chart propped against it. There are NO ladles, spoons, tongs or towels in that crate. Dangdang stands on the floor beside the stove, holding a wooden bowl of hot soup up in front of his face with both paws (the bowl sits in his paws), blowing on it to cool it: a small puff of breath and a wisp of steam over the bowl, both eyes closed happily the same way.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen.webp

event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen_r3.why: 連帶修正（工單外）：主文與 r1 的備用品盒是裝手裡劍與小炸彈的開口木箱，這張卻是另一個掀蓋小寶箱、裡面放紅色藥瓶，地上還多一張爪印紙條；同一個「備用品盒」三張長得不一樣。文字要有「修好鬆掉的蓋子」，所以箱子加一片木蓋。坐著吃燉肉的動作是對的，保留。
event_dangdang_noisy_kitchen_r3.scene: SETTING: the SAME kitchen corner as in reference image 3, on the same small patch of rough stone floor: the stone stove with the glowing fire, the big dark iron soup pot full of stew with steam rising, and the small paper note with the ink drawing of a steaming bowl stuck on the stove front. Right beside Dangdang stands the SAME SPARE NINJA-TOOL BOX as in reference image 3 (the same wooden crate with the silver throwing stars and small round black bombs inside), now with a flat wooden lid fitted on the back edge and propped HALF OPEN, straight and neat (he has just fixed the loose lid), so the throwing stars and bombs inside still show. Dangdang sits on the floor beside the stove, happily eating: he holds a wooden bowl of stew in one paw (the bowl sits in his paw) and with a wooden spoon in his other paw lifts a big soft chunk of stewed meat toward his mouth. Both eyes closed happily the same way, a contented smile.

event_dangdang_weapon_rack_r1.why: 文字是把整批舊兵器交給回收商、老鼠搬上車、付清小魚乾，噹噹把滑到車邊的鐵棍推回去；圖裡兵器架還掛滿兵器，車上只有幾件。
event_dangdang_weapon_rack_r1.scene: SETTING: the SAME freestanding wooden weapon rack as in reference image 3, standing on a small patch of dusty stone floor, with the same three paper technique drawings still pinned along its top board. The rack is now EMPTY of weapons: every sword, spear, mace, axe and halberd has been taken off - only the bare wooden pegs and hooks remain on plain dark wooden boards (no dust outlines, no marks, no shapes on the boards). To the right, the SAME small grey rat with big pink ears and a ragged brown vest from reference image 3 grips the handles of his small wooden hand cart, which is now piled HIGH with all the rusty old weapons (rusty swords, spears, a spiked mace, an axe, a curved halberd blade) heaped inside the cart. The rat looks pleased. A small heap of dried silver fish lies on the floor in front of Dangdang - the rat's payment. Dangdang stands at the left end of the cart; his RIGHT paw presses on a long rusty iron rod that was sliding off the edge of the cart and pushes it back into the pile - the rod rests in the cart, under his paw. Calm, contented face.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_weapon_rack.webp

the weapon rack of this same event to copy exactly (the tall dark wooden rack with its posts and the three paper technique drawings along the top), and the small grey rat in a ragged brown vest with his wooden hand cart. In the new picture the rack has NO weapons left on it and the weapons are all in the cart. Do NOT copy Dangdang's pose.

event_dangdang_moving_rat.why: 老鼠一臉奸笑、伸長手去碰噹噹的錢袋，像在扒竊；文字是老鼠邊數家當邊嘆氣、好聲好氣提議交換，只是指著行囊。
event_dangdang_moving_rat.scene: SETTING: a few wide grey stone steps on a small patch of stone floor. The SAME big brown rat as in reference image 3 (brown fur, pink ears, long pink tail, a huge patched burlap bundle tied with rope on his back) sits on one of the stone steps. Laid out in a row on the step beside him are a few of his belongings: a small rolled scroll, a little cloth pouch, a few gold coins and a string of wooden beads. He touches the coins with one paw, counting them, and sighs: a tired, troubled face with eyebrows tilted up, droopy half-closed eyes, a small white sigh puff near his mouth - friendly and a little worn out, NO grin, NO scheming look. His other paw points politely toward the small brown pouch hanging at Dangdang's waist sash - just pointing from where he sits; his paw stays far away from the pouch, NOT reaching for it and NOT touching it. Dangdang stands on the floor a short distance away (a clear gap between them), facing the rat and listening with a calm, slightly thoughtful face; one paw rests on his own pouch at his waist.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_moving_rat_r0.webp

the rat of this same event to copy: the big brown rat with pink ears and tail and his huge patched burlap bundle tied with rope, and his belongings (rolled scroll, cloth pouch, gold coins, wooden beads). Copy his look, not his pose, and do NOT copy Dangdang's pose.

event_dangdang_shortcut_scroll.why: 卷軸從上到下寫滿十幾行墨字；文字說只有一行大字「一練就會」加底下一行小字「後果自負」，噹噹往下找也沒有別的說明。
event_dangdang_shortcut_scroll.scene: SETTING: the SAME rough grey stone-block wall on a small patch of stone floor as in reference image 3, with the same long paper scroll hanging down its front from two nails, its bottom end curling on the floor. The scroll is almost BLANK: at the very top there is ONE row of four big, bold, fresh black brush strokes (abstract brush marks, not readable letters), with one small wet ink drip running down from them; directly under them ONE short row of small thin brush marks. EVERYTHING below that is empty plain paper - no more rows, no more marks, no pictures. Dangdang stands beside the lower part of the scroll, bending forward and lifting the empty lower edge of the paper a little with one paw, peering down the blank paper, searching for more instructions and finding none. Puzzled, faintly annoyed face: eyebrows lowered, mouth a small flat line. Do NOT fill the scroll with rows of writing.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_shortcut_scroll_r0.webp

the stone wall and the hanging paper scroll of this same event: copy the wall and the scroll's size and shape. Its MISTAKE, which must NOT be repeated: the scroll is covered with a dozen rows of ink scribbles from top to bottom - in the new picture the scroll has only one row of big strokes and one row of small marks at the top, the rest is blank paper. Do NOT copy Dangdang's pose.

event_dangdang_shortcut_scroll_r0.why: 跟主圖同一卷：舊圖卷軸上下寫滿十幾行墨字，主圖改成只有一行大字加一行小字後，這張要跟著改，否則同一卷前後不一。姿勢（收勢卡住、咬牙）是對的，保留。
event_dangdang_shortcut_scroll_r0.scene: SETTING: the SAME stone wall and the SAME hanging paper scroll as in reference image 3 - copy the scroll exactly: almost blank paper with ONE row of four big bold black brush strokes at the top (abstract marks, not letters) with a small ink drip, ONE short row of small marks under them, and the rest of the paper completely EMPTY. Dangdang stands in front of the scroll, practising: he tries to pull back into his finishing stance and gets stuck halfway - feet in a wide stance, his forearms with the copper bracers raised stiffly in front of his chest, his body frozen in an awkward jerk. Frustrated face: gritted teeth, lowered eyebrows, a small sweat drop, a tiny jolt mark by his elbow.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_shortcut_scroll.webp

event_dangdang_shadow_loose.why: 整段重點是影子「每一招都擋得很漂亮，腳卻站得太近」，圖裡影子卻是兩腳大開的弓步。
event_dangdang_shadow_loose.scene: SETTING: the SAME torch-lit stone room corner as in reference image 3: a stone-block floor, a lit iron wall torch on the left wall, and a long bare stone wall on the right. Dangdang stands on the floor in the bright torchlight, turned toward the right wall, startled (mouth open, a small surprise mark), pointing at the wall with one paw. The floor around his feet has NO shadow at all. On the right wall is his SHADOW: a flat dark silhouette of Dangdang with the chunky bracer shapes on its forearms. The shadow stands in a neat upright BLOCKING pose - both forearms raised in front of its face in a tidy guard - but its two feet are placed much TOO CLOSE together: the feet almost touch each other, the legs straight and narrow like standing at attention. It is NOT a lunge and the legs are NOT spread apart. The shadow's head is turned back over its shoulder toward Dangdang, as if it has just noticed being seen.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_shadow_loose.webp

the PREVIOUS, WRONG version of this same picture: copy its stone room corner, the wall torch and Dangdang pointing at the wall. Its mistake, which must NOT be repeated: the shadow on the wall stands in a wide lunge with its feet far apart - in the new picture the shadow's feet stand close together, almost touching.

event_dangdang_shadow_study_r1.why: 文字是噹噹靠在門外（門縫邊）看影子一遍遍練，天快亮時影子收勢、朝門縫看一眼、從窗口溜走；舊圖噹噹站在練功房裡面擺拳架。
event_dangdang_shadow_study_r1.scene: SETTING: the SAME practice room as in reference image 3, seen the same way: on the left the tall sliding paper door with its wooden frame standing open only a narrow gap, and inside the room the wooden floor, a glowing paper lantern, the wooden training dummy, and a window in the back wall showing a pale dawn sky. Dangdang is OUTSIDE the room, on the near side of the paper door at the left edge of the picture: he leans his shoulder against the outside of the door's wooden frame and peeks in through the narrow gap with a thoughtful, knowing look. He is NOT inside the room and NOT in a fighting stance: his arms are lowered, relaxed. Inside the room, the SHADOW - the dark violet-black smoky copy of Dangdang with glowing violet eyes and dark bracers, exactly like in reference image 3 - is climbing out through the window, one leg already over the sill, and looks back over its shoulder straight toward the door gap where Dangdang is peeking. The wooden training dummy stands pushed back and tilted from its last blow.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_shadow_study.webp

the main picture of this same event: copy the practice room (the sliding paper door on the left, the wooden floor, the paper lantern, the wooden training dummy) and the SHADOW's look (dark violet-black smoky Dangdang copy with glowing violet eyes and purple smoke). In this picture too, Dangdang stays OUTSIDE the door, peeking in through the gap.

event_dangdang_rat_bathhouse_r1.why: 文字是噹噹不付錢、抱著工具袋坐在門邊蹭熱氣，老鼠掌櫃瞪他，他指指門上歪掉的木牌；舊圖他站著伸手推木牌，工具袋掛在腰上。
event_dangdang_rat_bathhouse_r1.scene: SETTING: the SAME stone bathhouse as in reference image 3: an arched stone doorway with a hanging wooden sign (a simple hot-spring steam symbol) above it, wall torches, a wooden counter, shelves of bags behind the counter, and round wooden bathtubs giving off white steam. The wooden sign above the doorway hangs CROOKED, clearly tilted to one side. Dangdang SITS on the stone floor right beside the doorway, his legs stretched out in front of him. His LEFT arm hugs his brown tool bag tightly against his chest; warm white steam drifts over him and his arms, and he looks cosy. His RIGHT paw points up at the crooked sign, with a calm, matter-of-fact face. He has not paid: no fish, no coins anywhere near him. Behind the counter, the SAME grey MOUSE KEEPER with big pink ears as in reference image 3 glares at Dangdang with narrowed eyes and crossed arms.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_rat_bathhouse.webp

the main picture of this same event: copy the bathhouse (arched stone doorway, the wooden sign with the steam symbol, torches, wooden counter, shelves of bags, steaming wooden tubs) and the grey mouse keeper's look. event_dangdang_heavy_door_r1.why: 石門門縫只剩一條細線，整籃魚卻已在門外，籃子不可能從那條縫拉出來；主圖門縫寬得多。要讓門縫寬度和籃子合理、跟主圖一致。
event_dangdang_heavy_door_r1.scene: SETTING: the SAME massive grey stone door, stone-block door frame and rough stone floor as in reference image 3, seen at the same three-quarter angle. The door is stuck almost shut with the SAME gap as in reference image 3: a narrow vertical gap between the door and the frame, just wide enough for a cat's paw and forearm, with warm light inside. Just inside the gap, on the floor of the dim room, sits the small woven basket full of dried fish - the basket stays INSIDE; it is wider than the gap and does not come through. Dangdang stands right at the gap, one shoulder against the stone door, and has pushed his bare RIGHT arm through the gap up to the elbow; his paw hooks the rim of the basket and tips it toward the gap, and the dried fish slide out through the gap: several dried fish already lie in a small heap on the floor in front of his feet. Concentrated face, both eyes narrowed the same way, mouth closed.
refs: bg/event_dangdang_heavy_door.webp

the main picture of this same event: copy the stone door, its stone-block frame, the rough stone floor, the width of the gap and the small woven fish basket just inside it. Do NOT copy Dangdang's pose.
event_dangdang_heavy_door_r1.gear_off: he has taken off his RIGHT copper bracer to fit his arm through the gap: that bracer lies on the stone floor next to his feet, and his right forearm reaching into the gap is bare black-and-white fur. His LEFT forearm still wears its copper bracer. Never draw a bracer floating or a third bracer.
